tables.name: Table on slide 1: Lecture 4 - Modified Functional Ambulation Categories

content.text:
Categories | S tage | Definition
I | Lyer | Unable to walk / unable to sit without support>1min / assist to sit
II | Sitter | Sit without support >1min / unable to walk with 1 person assistance
III | Dependent walker | Walk with 1 person assistance – level ground (continuous manual contact to support body weight)
IV | Assisted walker | Walk with 1 person assistance – level ground (continuous or intermittent manual contact)
V | Supervised walker | Walk with standby guarding from 1 person – level ground
VI | Indoor walker | Transfer, turn & walk on level ground independently, needs assistance on stairs/inclines
VII | Outdoor walker | Walk independently on level or non-level surfaces
